# shopify_delivery_profile (Resource)

The store's general delivery profile. It always exists: create takes it over, destroy only removes it from state. Terraform owns the zones and rates in it; ones missing from config are deleted. Import with `default`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The store's general profile; Terraform owns its zones and rates.
resource "shopify_delivery_profile" "general" {
  location_group {
    location_ids = [shopify_location.warehouse_hamburg.id]

    zone {
      name      = "Germany"
      countries = ["DE"]

      method {
        name     = "Standard"
        price    = "4.95"
        currency = "EUR"
      }

      # Same name as above: rates are matched by name plus condition.
      method {
        name      = "Standard"
        price     = "0.00"
        currency  = "EUR"
        condition = { field = "TOTAL_PRICE", operator = "GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO", value = "49.00" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location_group` (Block List) Groups of locations that share zones and rates, matched by position. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--location_group))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Delivery profile GID.
- `name` (String) Profile name.

<a id="nestedblock--location_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location_group`

Required:

- `location_ids` (Set of String) Location GIDs that ship with these rates.

Optional:

- `zone` (Block List) Shipping zones, matched by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--location_group--zone))

<a id="nestedblock--location_group--zone"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location_group.zone`

Required:

- `countries` (Set of String) Country codes; `*` is the rest of the world. All provinces are included when the set changes.
- `name` (String) Zone name, unique within the location group.

Optional:

- `method` (Block List) Shipping rates. Matched by `name` plus `condition`, so a flat and a free-over-X rate may share a name. Carrier-calculated rates are not managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--location_group--zone--method))

<a id="nestedblock--location_group--zone--method"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location_group.zone.method`

Required:

- `currency` (String) Currency code of the price and of price conditions, e.g. `EUR`.
- `name` (String) Rate name shown at checkout.
- `price` (String) Flat price as a decimal string, e.g. `"4.95"`.

Optional:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the rate is offered. Defaults to `true`.
- `condition` (Attributes) Only offer the rate when the order total or weight meets this condition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location_group--zone--method--condition))
- `description` (String) Rate description.

<a id="nestedatt--location_group--zone--method--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location_group.zone.method.condition`

Required:

- `field` (String) `TOTAL_PRICE` or `TOTAL_WEIGHT`.
- `operator` (String) `GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO` or `LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO`.
- `value` (String) Threshold as a decimal string.

Optional:

- `unit` (String) Weight unit for `TOTAL_WEIGHT`: `KILOGRAMS`, `GRAMS`, `POUNDS` or `OUNCES`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Only the general profile is supported.
terraform import shopify_delivery_profile.general default
```
